descriptions.zh:
- 支持分页
- 支持按照插件业务类型查询
- 支持按照插件ID查询
- 支持按照插件名称查询
descriptions.en:
- This operation supports pagination.

- This operation allows you to query plug-ins by business type.

- This operation allows you to query plug-ins by ID.

- This operation allows you to query plug-ins by name.
